title: GE2TS pipeline parameters
description: Genetic Effects to Transcriptomic Scores Pipeline

input.description: Path to raw GWAS summary statistics input file (.tsv or .tsv.gz)

input_prep.description: Path to pre-prepared GWAS file (skips GWAS_PREP step)

input_genes_out.description: Path to pre-computed MAGMA genes output (skips GWAS_PREP and MAGMA_ANNOT_RUN steps)

bfile.description: Path or prefix to PLINK binary reference dataset

gene_loc.description: Path to gene location file (e.g. NCBI37.3.gene.loc)

hic_bed.description: Optional Hi-C mappable regions BED file

pathways.description: Path to pathway database in GMT format

window.description: MAGMA annotation window size in kb (e.g. 10,10 or 100,100)

stop_at_prep.description: Stop pipeline after GWAS preparation step

skip_gsea.description: Stop pipeline after MAGMA gene analysis step

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved
